summary: AIOS Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notification that it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company demonstrated a closing bid price at or above $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days from April 27 to May 8, 2026. The matter is now closed. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved. The filing simply confirms the company met an exchange listing standard, with no further implications for corporate structure or capital returns.
